technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with strong momentum (RSI rising, three white soldiers, force index cross) offset by weak trend confirmation (ADX 24.34, broken MA alignments, price outside Ichimoku cloud) and overbought stochRSI—moderate swing entry with elevated risk.

fundamental.summary: AEE shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 76 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak sell signal from junior representative with small position sales 115+ days ago; neutral market sentiment and absent news data provide no confirmation or contradiction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (186.7) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures utility revenues, and earnings in 76 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + RSI rising + force index cross-up + supertrend bullish show genuine short-term momentum with price near support (76.71), offering a defined risk entry for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 186.7, rising DXY), fundamentals are absent (zero insider conviction, no institutional signal, high earnings risk in 76 days), and technical confirmation is broken (ADX weak at 24.34, price outside Ichimoku cloud, below 50/200 EMAs, stochRSI overbought)—momentum alone cannot overcome this confluence of headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Three white soldiers + RSI rising + force index cross-up provide genuine short-term momentum at support (76.71), but this is insufficient to justify entry given severe macro headwinds and absent fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis (186.7) + earnings event in 76 days create a hostile macro environment where momentum-only trades face elevated drawdown risk; broken MA confirmations and overbought stochRSI suggest momentum is exhausted.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical momentum cannot overcome macro + fundamental weakness
